name: Anzens USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Anzens' U.S.-MSB-licensed dollar stablecoin on Cardano, redeemable 1:1 against USD cash and Treasuries custodied by BitGo Trust.
collateral: USD and dollar-equivalent reserves including U.S. Treasuries, held in segregated accounts custodied by BitGo Trust (Qualified Custodian)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 USD redemption through Anzens via KYC-verified bank transfers; minting and burning available to retail and institutional users in eligible U.S. states

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Anzens' current terms and EMURGO's launch announcement describe a fully reserved, Cardano-native USDA issued through the Anzens portal with issuer-operated mint and burn flows, establishing the fiat-cash archetype.
